def template_for(blob, definitions):
    printable = all(32 <= value < 127 or value in (13, 10, 9) for value in blob)
    if printable and len(blob) <= 60000:
        return blob.decode('ascii')
    names = []
    for index in range(0, max(1, len(blob)), 1200):
        chunk = blob[index:index + 1200]
        name = 'P%d_%d' % (PIECES[0], len(names))
        definitions.append([name, 'b"%s"' % ''.join('\x%02x' % value for value in chunk)])
        names.append(name)
    PIECES[0] += 1
    return '{{' + ' + '.join(names) + '}}'


def channel_blob(blob, owner=None, extra=None):
    definitions = []
    parts = [{'case': owner, 'data': template_for(blob, definitions)}]
    for item in (extra or []):
        parts.append({'case': item[0], 'data': template_for(item[1], definitions)})
    doc = {'seed': 's', 'definitions': definitions, 'timeout_ms': 1,
           'cases': [], 'events': [], 'channels': [{'name': 'e', 'parts': parts}]}
    return run(doc)['channels'][0]


def check(name, got, want):
    global failures
    if got != want:
        failures += 1
        print('FAIL', name)
        print('  got ', str(got)[:400])
        print('  want', str(want)[:400])
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)

    return [('ok', item['framing'], item['body']['n'], item['start'], item['end'],
             item['host_count'], item['flags']) for item in row['requests']]

    if row['error'] is not None:
        return ('error', row['error']['kind'], row['error']['offset'])
    return records(row)


def full(row):
    return (records(row),
